title: Magnetic Field Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the magnetic field B(t) inside the solenoid must be correctly derived and presented.

title: Electric Field Inside
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the electric field E(t) inside the solenoid must be correctly derived and presented.

title: Electric Field Outside
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the electric field E(t) outside the solenoid must be correctly derived and presented.

title: Time Dependency
description: Important Criteria: The student must evaluate the electric field at t = 2π/ω and express it correctly for both inside and outside the solenoid.

title: Field Line Sketch
description: Optional Criteria: A sketch showing the shape of the electric field lines should be included to illustrate the concept.

title: Magnitude Graph
description: Optional Criteria: A graph showing how the magnitude of E depends on the distance from the axis of the solenoid at t = 2π/ω should be included.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors include incorrect signs in the expressions for the electric and magnetic fields.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that all units are consistent and correctly applied throughout the solution.
